blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Token source and security docs expose per-account freezing, forced transfers and global pause. Current independent role reads on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Monad and Base confirm the issuer holds FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE and FORCED_TRANSFER_MANAGER_ROLE. Base block52110793 totalSupply=100000raw(0.1PYUSDx). An additional0G exact native deployment has zero supply at block46024355 but its transfer controls are not reviewed or added to the catalog. Terms section11 applies freezing, seizure, forfeiture and potential destruction to all holders, not only eligible counterparties.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Four catalogued native deployments transfer through Portal burn/mint and LayerZero V2. Independent RPC resolves the shared3-of-5 Safe v1.4.1 administrator, both bridge ProxyAdmin owners, exact getPeer(uint32) native-chain mappings and two-required-DVN configurations on the eight active directed pathways (Ethereum/Arbitrum/Monad plus Ethereum/Base). No Safe modules or guard are detected at the current pins; fallback handler0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99 is present. Signer independence, fallback execution safeguards, enforced upgrade delay and numeric route limits remain unresolved. Ethereum additionally peers to0G(chain16661); that exact native token has zero supply at block46024355 and is evidenced without registering the chain.
